title: Make an API route in 4 lines
why_it_matters: You get a backend endpoint with no extra server.
explanation: A route.js file inside the app folder defines an API endpoint. Export a function named after the HTTP method. Return a Response. The folder path becomes the URL, so app/api/hello/route.js serves /api/hello.
try_it: Open /api/hello in your browser and read the JSON.
